title: Reject unknown configuration keys safely
prompt: Change the config.toml parser so every key absent from allowed_keys returns a structured error containing the key name and source line number. Preserve redaction: the error must never include the key's value, including when that value is a secret.
objective: Configuration typos fail with a precise, secret-free diagnostic instead of being silently ignored.
context: src/parser.rs currently skips keys not found in allowed_keys.
tests/parser.rs contains the existing strictness and diagnostic coverage.
requirements: Return an error for the first unknown key in config.toml.
Include the unknown key name and line number in the diagnostic.
Never include the configuration value in the diagnostic or logs.
constraints: Keep allowed_keys as the source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: An unknown key produces an error naming that key and its line number.
A secret value assigned to an unknown key does not appear in the error or captured logs.
Every currently allowed configuration key still parses.
assumptions: The TOML parser exposes source spans for keys.
